$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026. Not a lodge - a 75ft liveaboard dhow (boat) for Lamu Archipelago coastal exploration. Priced per boat per night, not per person.

rates.unit: per boat per night (min stay 2 nights, 4 guests)

capacity: 3 air-conditioned cabins, up to 8 people; also open-deck star-sleeping

childPolicy.note: Not suitable for children under 6 years.

inclusions: Full board, soft drinks/local beers/non-premium wines/spirits, Manda airstrip transfers, statutory taxes, laundry, tidal floats, snorkelling, inshore fishing, Lamu shopping, dolphin watching, cultural experiences, nature walks, historical sites, beach picnics, weaving, birdwatching, watersports, sundowners.
exclusions: Community Heritage fee, bespoke diving, private leisure boat, privately guided fly fishing, deep sea fishing.
notes: Exclusive use minimum charge is 4 adults.
